title: Domaine Pterion Vineyard & Winery

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Domaine Pterion: Vineyard & Winery is a picturesque location for weddings, showers, corporate retreats, and celebrations of life events. Domaine Pterion: Vineyard & Winery features 60 acres of property with picturesque vineyards, a fully renovated historic bank barn from 1780, and beautifully matured landscapes. The estate offers several venue spaces and can accommodate up to 160 guests. Whether you are dreaming of an intimate outdoor event surrounded by the beauty of the vineyard or a larger celebration of a meaningful life milestone, Domaine Pterion can help bring your vision to life. Several packages are offered to provide guests with a unique and memorable

services.name: Open Tasting Sundays
services.desc: Domaine Pterion: Vineyard & Winery invites you to visit for wine tastings on location. Come for wine tasting open hours on Sundays. Enjoy live music and sample our wines grown on property, all while relaxing in our atmospheric tasting lounge or outdoor patio with beautiful views of the property. We offer a variety of food pairings to go along with our wines. We would appreciate it if you would please not bring outside food. Occasionally the property is closed for private events.
